import re

# Find all gallery mentions with their positions
gallery_pattern = r'Gallery (?:of )?(?:the )?(\w+(?:\s+\w+)*)'
matches = list(re.finditer(gallery_pattern, text))

print("Gallery visits in order:")
visits = []
for i, match in enumerate(matches):
    gallery_name = "Gallery of the " + match.group(1)
    visits.append(gallery_name)
    print(f"{i+1}. {gallery_name}")

print(f"\nTotal visits: {len(visits)}")

# Find the 3rd visit to Gallery of the Mystics
mystics_count = 0
for i, visit in enumerate(visits):
    if "Mystics" in visit:
        mystics_count += 1
        print(f"\nVisit #{i+1} is the {mystics_count}nd/rd/th visit to Gallery of the Mystics")
        if mystics_count == 3:
            print(f"The 3rd visit to Gallery of the Mystics is at position {i+1}")
            if i > 0:
                print(f"The gallery visited immediately before was: {visits[i-1]}")
            break"}<|tool_call_end|><|tool_calls_section_end|>
